title: A learned prover exposed ambiguous translations of unique-answer math problems
summary: A learned prover found two distinct Lean-accepted answers for 5.4% of the tested formal statements pooled across three autoformalizers. The original problems had unique answers, so these examples expose a mismatch between the formal statements and their intended problems.

source_review.scope: v1 Methods, unique-answer argument, Appendix D Table 5

evidence.tested: The audit combined evidence from two learned provers across three autoformalizers and five contest problem datasets. Lean checked acceptance of distinct answers.
evidence.unknown: The detected rate is a lower bound for these tested versions. A translation can be wrong in ways this multiple-answer test does not flag.
evidence.ai_role: Gobble-Prover models generated verifiable proof terms for numerical candidates under independently autoformalized competition problems.
